characterList.description: The teacher is a young man with short black hair wearing a pale violet shirt with thin white lines, a silver ring on his left ring finger and a black watch on his left wrist. He stands in front of a white board.
characterList.name: Teacher

content_metadata.description: A teacher explains how to solve a physics problem involving tension force and momentum.

qAndA.question: What is the mass of the humpback whale?
What is the mass of the tugboat?
What is the initial velocity of the tugboat?
What is the average frictional force experienced by the whale?
What is the average force on the rope during the tow?

scenes.contextualRelevance: This scene matches a real-life physics classroom scenario where students learn problem-solving skills related to forces and motion.

narrativeProgression.description: The teacher draws a diagram to help explain the problem.
The teacher writes down the equations needed to solve the problem.

scenes.title: Physics Problem Solving

climax.description: The climax occurs as the teacher summarizes the solution approach.

storylines.description: The teacher walks through the steps of solving a physics problem involving a whale and a tugboat.
